purpose: human-first simulation input with school-grounded major confirmation and compact A4 family worksheet PDF
rules: visible input never waits for school resolver or network
school candidates preserve province city and level metadata
school confirmation requires an explicit candidate action and strict resolve
major directory candidates remain directory hints
school-grounded major candidates are actual school records
major confirmation requires school name plus major name plus code agreement
confirmed major history is derived only from returned school-major records
history years use the lowest available score per year for the confirmed school-major record set
missing historical years are explicit no-strict-record values
historical scores are reference-only and never create a needs-check state
candidate controls survive unrelated legacy DOM mutations and remain directly clickable
stale worker and network responses cannot overwrite newer input
release revisions increment for every revision
the current page has one canonical candidate click path
historical simulation-report workflows are manual-only
canonical gate executes the current v017 direct-action browser regression
canonical browser regression includes Shenyang Chemical University plus polymer materials
school candidate execution uses the shared v150 catalog resolver inside a dedicated module Worker
school search is debounced inside the Worker and superseded sequences are never executed or emitted
the common admission directory begins loading when the Worker starts so the first school input does not boot the directory pipeline
direct school-name matches use the admission directory before the heavier v150 catalog resolver
exact school confirmation also resolves from the warm admission directory before falling back to the heavier catalog resolver
input performance is measured on the synchronous input-dispatch path
PDF uses compact flowing volunteer rows rather than one card per page
A4 pagination is decided before rasterization from measured page content bounds, not fixed container height
two short volunteer entries share a page when they fit
a single A4 page targets a batch of compact volunteer rows rather than one volunteer per page
each continued PDF page repeats student/score/context header
print output prioritizes school, major, three-year history, family decision and reserved verification space
history-only records never create PDF needs-check labels
transient school directory or catalog load failures must not permanently poison the Worker cache
v016.50/r140 fixes premature A4 pagination and namespaces PDF layout styles to prevent global CSS collisions
